snippet_primary: "Amazon Handmade enables a reach of 300 million potential customers while Etsy covers 'only' 90 million. Amazon's fees are high (15% referral on each sale) and the in-house regulations when it comes to marketing your products are stricter. Etsy ($0.20 per item) tends to be more economical and offers you more freedom when it comes to branding."
subject_exact: comparative reach and fee claims between Amazon Handmade (300 million potential customers, 15% referral fee, stricter marketing rules) and Etsy (90 million, $0.20 per item, more branding freedom)
local_qualifiers: 300 million potential customers (Amazon Handmade) vs 90 million (Etsy)
